title: Hunger Games Mini Games
description: This project creates a real mods of Hunger Games games fully configurable. BETA
body:
🔥Hunger Games - Fully Configurable Mod 🔥

Immerse yourself in a fully customisable Hunger Games experience with this mod designed to offer complete control over every aspect of the game.

Whether you want to faithfully recreate the original Hunger Games or invent your own rules, everything is configurable:

⚙️ Game settings (time, players, zones, events)

🎒 Loot and equipment

🗺️ Arenas and game limits

⏱️ Phases of the game (beginning, middle, end)

💥 Special events and personalised mechanics

The mod is designed for both competitive servers and games with friends, with a simple, flexible and powerful configuration.

🎯 Objective: to offer a unique, balanced and renewable Hunger Games experience for each game.

Create your own rules. Launch the game. That only one survives.
